correctness.rationale: One-coordinate generator tests give the two conditional laws exactly. The residuals are \(\dot u\) and \(\dot v/v\), so conditional orthogonality gives both variance/activity decompositions. For the support envelope, \(U=\operatorname*{ess\,sup}u\) and \(\mathbb E[u\mid v]=(F+k)/v\) imply \(v\ge(F+k)/U\); inserting this into the first conditional law yields \(FU^2-FU+(F+k)^2\le0\), which gives the discriminant and upper equilibrium branch. Vanishing of either activity defect makes one coordinate constant on complete support trajectories and then forces the other coordinate constant, so the support is equilibrium-only. The packaged exact checker reproduces all algebraic steps.

value.rationale: The two nonlinear quantities \(uv^2\) and \(uv\) are the defining autocatalytic transfer rates in the homogeneous Gray–Scott kinetics. The theorem turns both deterministic nullclines into exact stationary fiberwise calibrations and identifies their deviations with measurable kinetic activity. The support envelope ties those statistical laws to the classical positive-equilibrium boundary, giving exact consistency tests for periodic-orbit computations and homogeneous kinetic data without requiring ergodicity or a chosen orbit.
